description: Wolfire Workspace helps authorized game developers inspect their games, dated store checks, saved build provenance and release reports. Ask what needs attention and follow evidence back to the dashboard. Prepare public listing observations for review; saving requires confirmation in the dashboard. Requires an invited workspace account. This plugin does not run builds, download artifacts or publish releases.
